note.zh-TW: 模板的籌資活動沒有長期借款列，網站以延伸列處理；教材部分頁面稱這一類為長期負債（舊稱）。
note.en: The template has no long-term borrowing lines in financing activities, so the site uses extension rows; some course pages call this group long-term liabilities, an older term.

definition.zh-TW:
向銀行等債權人借入、到期日在一年以後的借款。

它和短期借款的差別只在還款期限；利息同樣列在利息費用。
definition.en:
Money borrowed from banks or other lenders that falls due more than a year away.

It differs from short-term borrowings only in the repayment horizon; the interest is likewise recorded as interest expense.

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表非流動負債。借入時現金與長期借款一起增加，償還時一起減少；現金流量表列在籌資活動的延伸列（老師的模板沒有長期借款列）。長期資金占固定資產比率把它算進長期資金。本課故事沒有用到。
example.en: Where it sits: non-current liabilities on the balance sheet. Borrowing raises cash and this liability together; repayment lowers both. The statement of cash flows shows it on extension lines under financing activities (the course template has no long-term borrowing lines). The ratio of long-term funds to property, plant and equipment counts it as long-term funding. The course story does not use it.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為一年內就要還的那一部分也可以繼續留在長期借款。到期日進入一年以內的部分要轉列流動負債，否則流動比率會被高估。
misconception.en: Leaving the portion due within the next year in long-term borrowings. Amounts falling due within twelve months must be reclassified to current liabilities, otherwise the current ratio is overstated.
